rows.note: Use 麥 as the short everyday term when the context makes wheat clear.

example.english: This bakery uses good wheat flour to make bread.
example.traditional: 呢間麵包店用靚麥粉整麵包。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 min6 baau1 dim3 jung6 leng3 mak6 fan2 zing2 min6 baau1

rows.note: Use 小麥 when you need to specify wheat precisely rather than cereal grains generally.

example.english: This bag is wheat flour, not corn flour.
example.traditional: 呢包係小麥粉，唔係粟米粉。
example.jyutping: ne1 baau1 hai6 siu2 mak6 fan2 m4 hai6 suk1 mai5 fan2
